topic: Minimum Attendance Requirement to Sit for End-Semester Examinations
description: Clause 4.2 of Academic Regulations mandates strict 75% attendance with zero exceptions. Clause 9.1 allows 65% with medical exemption. Clause 14.3 empowers the Dean with unconditional unilateral discretion to waive attendance down to 50%.

clauses.quote: A student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each registered course to be eligible to appear for the end-semester examination. Under no circumstances whatsoever shall any condonation or relaxation be granted below this 75% absolute threshold, regardless of medical emergencies, official representations, or administrative discretion.

Students who fail to meet the standard attendance criterion due to certified hospitalization or prolonged illness verified by the Chief Medical Officer may be granted condonation of up to 10%, permitting them to sit for examinations with an attendance threshold of not less than 65%.

Notwithstanding any general regulation or specific clause contained herein, the Dean of Academic Affairs possesses exclusive, final, and unconditional authority to waive attendance deficiencies down to a minimum of 50% for students demonstrating exceptional merit, institutional service, or compassionate grounds.

sample_queries: What is the minimum attendance required to sit for exams if I have a medical certificate?
Can the Dean waive my attendance below 75% if I fall sick?
Is 75% attendance strictly mandatory with no exceptions allowed for exams?
What happens if my attendance is 68% due to hospitalization?

topic: Tuition Fee Refund on Course Withdrawal
description: Fee Schedule (Table Section B) guarantees an 80% tuition fee refund for any withdrawal within 14 calendar days of semester start. Academic Regulations Clause 6.4 strictly specifies that any course dropped or withdrawn after day 7 forfeits 100% of fees with zero refund.

clauses.section: Fee Schedule - Clause REF-02 (Early Withdrawal Bracket)
clauses.quote: Withdrawal submitted between Calendar Day 8 and Calendar Day 14 from semester commencement shall be entitled to an eighty percent (80%) refund of tuition fees, subject only to a deduction of Rs. 2,500 administrative processing fee.

clauses.section: Section 6.4 - Course Drop Deadlines and Financial Liability
clauses.quote: A student may drop a course without academic penalty up to Day 7 of instructional classes. If a course is dropped or a student withdraws from any course after Day 7 of the semester, the student incurs full financial liability and 100% fee forfeiture; absolutely zero refund of tuition or lab fees shall be sanctioned.

sample_queries: If I withdraw from a course on day 10 of the semester, what refund percentage do I get?
What is the refund policy if I drop a course in the second week?
Can I get an 80% fee refund if I withdraw on day 12?
Does dropping a course on day 9 forfeit 100% of my fees or do I get a refund?

topic: Night Campus Curfew vs Final Year 24/7 Lab Access
description: Hostel & Campus Life Handbook Clause 3.1 mandates that all campus gates and academic building doors lock at 10:00 PM sharp with all resident students confined inside hostels with no exceptions. Academic Regulations Clause 11.2 guarantees 24/7 unrestricted physical access to university research laboratories for all final-year project students.

clauses.section: Section 3.1 - Mandatory Campus Ingress & Night Curfew
clauses.quote: All campus entrance gates, library halls, and academic departmental complexes shall be locked strictly at 22:00 hours (10:00 PM). All resident students must be physically inside their assigned hostel blocks by 22:00 hours. No student is permitted outside their hostel block under any circumstance between 22:00 hours and 06:00 hours.

clauses.section: Section 11.2 - Senior Capstone Research Lab Access Protocol
clauses.quote: All registered final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students working on their capstone thesis or funded departmental research projects are guaranteed continuous 24-hour, seven-days-a-week (24/7) unrestricted physical and biometric access to academic department research laboratories and computational clusters.

sample_queries: Can final year students work in the departmental research labs after 10 PM?
Is there a 10 PM curfew for capstone project students working in the computing labs overnight?
Are campus academic buildings locked at 10 PM even for senior thesis researchers who have 24/7 lab access?
Can hostel students stay in the research lab past 10 PM?
